answer: Mooring-bond stops bulk fakes. In the open nebula each identity moors to a cedar anchor post, locks a 70-credit bond, and files the claim in a public mirror ledger. Each epoch one in eight moorings is audited: one key per post. A second claim on a post, or a rented post, burns the bond and flags the cluster. The k-th fake pays 45+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 and lock 70,000 vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its share.
